interpretation_boundary: Stage40 is the final post-hoc MK14/PPARG objective-development analysis. It reads only frozen training rows and cannot turn internal scaffold holdouts into independent validation. A positive efficacy gate would authorize one externally preregistered protein replication with no further weight changes. The separate difficulty gate only describes the present 16-receptor landscape. Neither gate authorizes quantum hardware or a quantum-advantage claim. A failed efficacy gate freezes further MK14/PPARG objective tuning and redirects the project to a quantum-application PoC or a new independently designed dataset.
